name: CAD Coin
oneLiner: CADC is a Canadian dollar stablecoin issued by CADC Reserve Trust, serviced by Loon Payments, and redeemable 1:1 for CAD held at ATB Financial.
collateral: Canadian-dollar cash held 1:1 in segregated accounts at ATB Financial, in trust for CADC holders
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for CAD; CADC is issued by CADC Reserve Trust under a final prospectus receipted by the Ontario Securities Commission on 2026-10-22, with servicer Loon Payments minting and burning through Authorized Participants such as Paytrie; tokens are minted only after CAD reaches the ATB Financial reserve account and burned on redemption

proofOfReserves.provider: Monthly scanned ATB Financial bank-confirmation forms for PayTrie AB Inc (the September 2026 form names no requesting accountant, supplies no accountant's opinion, and contains no CADC circulation or liability reconciliation)

notices.title: Legacy contract migration closes November 26, 2026
notices.message: Issuer CADC Reserve Trust distributes CADC on new Ethereum, Base, Polygon and Solana contracts and labels the tracked Ethereum, Base, Polygon and Solana addresses as legacy. Legacy CADC can be exchanged 1:1 at migrate.loon.finance or redeemed for CAD through Paytrie until the migration window closes on November 26, 2026. Arbitrum support is paused, the migration guidance does not address Linea, and Pharos supply still reads the legacy contracts.
